blocks.text: Chromosomal rearrangements (tarteeb ka badalna): chromosomes mein jismani tabdeeliyan aa sakti hain, jaise deletion (hissa nikal jana), duplication (hissa dohra ho jana), inversion (hissa ulat jana) aur translocation (hissa doosri jagah chala jana). Aam taur par yeh tabdeeliyan DNA double helix ke do mukhtalif jaghon se tootne se hoti hain. Translocation mein aik chromosome ka tukra doosre chromosome ka hissa ban jata hai. Inversion mein chromosome ke kisi hisse ka rukh ulat jata hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar rangeen hisse saath saath, har aik mein pattiyon wale chromosomes Before aur After aur hara teer. Deletion (peela): dabbe wala neela hissa gum. Duplication (gulabi): dabbe wala neela hissa do baar. Translocation (neela): chromosome 4 aur chromosome 20 ke dabbe wale sire jagah badal lete hain. Inversion (narangi): do toot ke darmiyan ka hissa ghoom jata hai (murre teer), rangeen pattiyan ulti tarteeb mein. Har chromosome ka centromere qaim rehta hai.

blocks.text: Insertional inactivation: chromosomes ke bohat se chhote tukre genome mein aik jagah se doosri jagah ja sakte hain; DNA ke in chalne phirne wale tukron ko transposons ya jumping genes kehte hain. Transposons apni nayi jagah ittefaqan (random) chunte hain. Kuch transposons genes ke andar ghus kar unhein bekaar (inactivate) kar dete hain. Mutation ki yeh qisam qudrat mein aam hai, aur bohat si insani genetic bimariyan isi transposition ka nateeja hain. Maslan aik insani transposon X chromosome par clotting factor IX ke gene mein ghus kar gene ke beech mein stop codon bana deta hai, jis se X-linked haemophilia hota hai.
